title: M4: Microsoft Teams, and Discord (deferred)
description:
Third transport is Teams through Bot Framework HTTPS (JWT validated, replies by Bot Connector REST). Discord is deferred: without the Gateway websocket it receives only slash commands, buttons and modals, so it is a possible later slash-command adapter, not a conversation surface. Each platform starts with a verification spike because registration rules change.

Depends on M2 (and benefits from M3 lessons).
